name: Can cove molding be installed on textured walls or ceilings?

mainEntity.name: Can cove molding be installed on textured walls or ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, cove molding can be installed on textured walls or ceilings, but it may require extra preparation to achieve a seamless look. For heavily textured surfaces, some light sanding or leveling of the area where the molding will sit might be necessary to ensure a flush fit and strong adhesion. This additional preparation is crucial for a clean aesthetic. Our installers address these conditions proactively, ensuring the molding integrates smoothly into your specific home environment. This attention to detail is part of our commitment to quality craftsmanship.
